cases.query: ¿Tener 37 grados de temperatura significa que tengo fiebre?

top5.response: Sí, tener una temperatura de 37 grados Celsius puede indicar que tienes fiebre.

sources.title: Influenza (Flu)
sources.section: Symptoms and Differences from a Cold

chunk.title: Fever
chunk.content: A fever means that body temperature is above a person's usual range. A temperature close to 37 °C (98.6 °F) is often described as an average normal temperature, but normal temperature varies among people and throughout the day. A reading of 37 °C by itself does not establish that someone has a fever. Fever is a sign, not a disease; it often accompanies the body's response to an infection.

chunk.title: Common Cold
chunk.content: Typical symptoms include sneezing, a runny or blocked nose, sore throat, cough, and sometimes headache. Symptoms generally begin a few days after infection and may continue for one to two weeks. Similar complaints can also occur with influenza or allergies, so symptoms alone do not always identify the cause.

chunk.title: Fever
chunk.content: Infections caused by viruses or bacteria account for many fevers. Other possible causes include certain medicines, heat-related illness, autoimmune diseases, some cancers, and some childhood vaccines. A temperature reading alone does not identify the cause of a person's symptoms.

chunk.title: Influenza (Flu)
chunk.section: Symptoms and Differences from a Cold
chunk.content: Flu symptoms often start abruptly and may include fever or chills, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, and marked tiredness. A runny or stuffy nose can also occur. Children sometimes experience vomiting or diarrhea. Compared with a common cold, influenza more often begins suddenly and causes substantial fever, aches, and fatigue; these patterns do not establish a diagnosis on their own.

chunk.title: Common Cold
chunk.content: A cold has no specific cure, and antibiotics do not treat cold viruses. Rest, fluids, saline nasal products, and other symptom-relief measures may help. Over-the-counter cold medicines require particular care in children; read labels to avoid taking duplicate ingredients. Medical advice is appropriate for breathing difficulty, dehydration, fever that persists, symptoms that fail to improve, or symptoms that improve and then worsen.

cases.query: ¿Qué desencadenantes frecuentes se asocian a la cefalea y cuáles son sus señales de alarma?

top5.response: Las principales causas frecuentes de la cegue (cerebrovascular accident) incluyen el estrés, la falta de sueño, el consumo excesivo de alcohol o medicamentos, y los cambios en la rutina diaria. Además, las personas pueden tener problemas con la memoria, la concentración, la percepción visual, la sensibilidad a la luz, y la sensibilidad a la temperatura. Si una persona experimenta un dolor de cabeza que proviene de una causa desconocida, es importante consultar a un profesional de la salud para determinar su causa y obtener tratamiento adecuado.

chunk.title: Allergies
chunk.content: Allergic reactions may cause sneezing, a runny nose, itching, skin rashes, swelling, or asthma-related symptoms. Some symptoms overlap with those of a common cold. The severity of reactions varies. Anaphylaxis is a severe allergic reaction that can be life-threatening and requires immediate emergency care.

chunk.title: Allergies
chunk.content: An allergy occurs when the immune system reacts to a substance that is harmless to most other people. Triggers can include pollen, dust mites, mold, pet dander, certain foods, insect stings, and medicines. A person may be sensitive to several different allergens.

chunk.title: Headache
chunk.content: Some headache patterns require prompt medical assessment. A sudden, very severe headache should be discussed urgently with a health care professional. Seek immediate medical help for headache following a head injury or headache accompanied by a stiff neck, fever, confusion, loss of consciousness, or significant eye or ear pain.

chunk.title: Headache
chunk.content: Tension-type headache is common and may involve tight muscles around the neck, shoulders, scalp, or jaw. Stress, lack of sleep, missed meals, and other lifestyle factors can contribute. Other headache types include migraine and cluster headache. Management may involve changes in habits, relaxation strategies, and suitable pain relief.

chunk.title: Dehydration
chunk.content: In adults, signs may include thirst, dry mouth, dark urine, reduced urination, tiredness, and dizziness. In babies and young children, warning signs include a dry mouth, few or no tears, fewer wet diapers, unusual sleepiness, irritability, or sunken-looking eyes. Confusion, fainting, very little or no urination, rapid breathing, or a fast heartbeat may indicate severe dehydration and require urgent medical care.

cases.query: En Demo Health Clinic, ¿con cuánto aviso se cancela un turno y cuánto lleva procesar una solicitud verificada de historia clínica?

top5.response: El tiempo que se le pide para cancelar un turno en Demo Health Clinic es de al menos 24 horas antes del evento. En cuanto a la procesamiento de una solicitud verificada de historia clínica, el tiempo que se le pide para hacerlo es de aproximadamente 7 días desde la fecha de la solicitud.
